decisions.reason: As a traditional rye country bread closely aligned with the bakery’s core daily assortment, it is likely to remain unless assortment simplification becomes necessary.
The premium raisin Christmas stollen is a flagship seasonal product with award-backed prestige and strong fit to the firm’s identity, so it should clearly stay.
The rye mixed bread with seeds matches demand for hearty, somewhat health-oriented breads and complements the core bread range well.
The dark barley malt rye bread still suits the artisanal bread profile, but its more niche positioning and overlap with other rye products leave a moderate withdrawal risk.
